BRANDING / 03 OF 07

Furr

Your body. Your choice.

A colourful visual world for Furr by Pee Safe, built around self-expression and personal choice.

THE PROJECT

The idea behind the identity.

Furr’s message is about choice: people should feel comfortable deciding how they care for their hair and body. The design expresses that idea through an upbeat palette, playful shapes and an approachable visual voice.

DESIGN DIRECTION

Personality without the pressure.

Soft organic forms and bright colours create a friendly, expressive system. The visual language gives product imagery and social content room to feel lively while staying recognisably part of the same brand.

THE VISUAL LANGUAGE

Colour sets the tone.

TYPOGRAPHY

Lemon Milk Light

A distinctive geometric typeface connecting headings and supporting communication.

IN APPLICATION

Products with a point of view.

Product imagery uses the brand’s colour and graphic language to create a consistent family across the range. Social designs bring that personality into everyday conversations about body hair and personal care.
